variants.title: Two-probe conductivity of a graphite rod
variants.sample: Graphite rod 0.5 mm in diameter, 10 cm between the probes
variants.unknown: the electrical conductivity of graphite at room temperature
variants.note: Graphite is a semimetal: no band gap, and its resistance changes only slowly with temperature. A low-resistance sample needs a large current and good contacts: even 5 milliohm per contact adds 0.2 % here. Resistivity of polycrystalline graphite about 1e-5 ohm m (it varies with the grade) - from memory - verify.
